note: Greene County park near Greeneville on the Nolichucky River (Davy Crockett Lake), with pool, mini golf, ballfields and a boat ramp; most sites full hookup. Some full-time residents share the campground, so call ahead for a transient site. Pad lengths not published. --Claude
